method.description: Viewed the supplied 12-frame contact sheet and three denser sheets extracted using OpenCV, covering every fourth frame plus final frame, in chronological order. Compared with full source image. No realtime playback claimed.

observations: Puppy identity, two ears, seated legs/paws, red collar/yellow tag, blue slipper with cyan sole and orange/green ball remain recognizable in the sampled sequence.
Visible head/ear sway, repeated natural-looking blink phases and small tail-tip movement provide a gentle idle animation; slipper follows the head while paws and ball remain stable.
Main colors and bold flat illustration style remain consistent; no extra limbs, prop disappearance, camera cut or obvious subject morphing appears in inspected frames.
Small tail tips alternately peek from behind the seated body; these read as occluded wagging, not extra legs. Motion is restrained rather than a large action sequence.
limitations: Frame sampling supports a visual motion gate but does not establish frame-perfect temporal smoothness, absence of all inter-sample artifacts or seamless looping.
scope: Exact-MP4 sampled visual reward-video gate. Does not approve processed painting assets or claim realtime playback.

user_review.feedback: User watched the dog reward video and confirmed they like it.
